title: Restriction of scalars detects pseudo-coherence
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The difficult direction builds a finite free approximation after extending scalars and lowers the highest nonzero cohomology degree by a cone. It proves that the cone preserves pseudo-coherence over the base and inductively recovers a finite approximation over the target algebra.
